endorsements.quote: Expand and strengthen continuing education and training for mental health professionals in genomics, omics sciences, digital health technologies, data science, and personalised approaches, enabling critical appraisal, appropriate use, and reduced resistance to innovation.

unlisted_practices: Increase investment in mental health research, particularly precision medicine, to levels commensurate with the burden of mental disorders.
Strengthen translational research pipelines to improve understanding of brain function and the biological mechanisms of mental disorders.
Prioritise sensitivity, reproducibility, and validation of biomarkers across diverse populations and care settings before incorporating them into clinical decision-making.
Promote dissemination of evidence-based, accessible information for health professionals, policymakers, patients, and the public to counter misinformation and reduce stigma.

Update and harmonise ethical and regulatory frameworks for AI, digital tools, and neurotechnologies in mental health, ensuring privacy protections, clear informed consent standards, transparency in decision-making, and defined limits for biomedical intervention.
Promote multidisciplinary and cross-sector collaboration across psychiatry, psychology, genetics, bioinformatics, engineering, and other fields to support integrated precision approaches.
Use real-world data, quality indicators, and patient-reported outcomes to iteratively assess the effectiveness, safety, and acceptability of precision psychiatry implementation.
Improve representativeness and diversity of research cohorts and adapt precision tools to diverse cultural and health-system contexts.
Ensure appropriate clinical oversight when using apps, wearables, and telepsychiatry for monitoring.
Apply explainability of AI tools and safeguards against stigma or misuse of predictive information.

screen.reason: This is an EPA Guidance Paper providing recommendations and strategic frameworks for the responsible integration of precision psychiatry and AI into mental healthcare.
